def evenOddRec {P : Nat → Sort u_1} (h0 : P 0) (h_even : (n : Nat) → P n → P (2 * n)) (h_odd : (n : Nat) → P n → P (2 * n + 1)) (n : Nat) : P n :=
  if n = 0 then
    h0
  else if n % 2 == 0 then
    let k := n / 2
    h_even k (evenOddRec h0 h_even h_odd k)
  else
    let k := n / 2
    h_odd k (evenOddRec h0 h_even h_odd k)
